title: Archive internal Pico deployment resources
goal: Add the approved internal PC Service installer, Pico APK, and reproducible XRoboToolkit SDK source/build materials to Release/resources with integrity manifests and installation documentation.
doneWhen: Release/resources contains the exact PC Service Debian installer and Pico APK with SHA-256 manifests and internal-use documentation.
Release/resources contains the MIT-licensed xrobotoolkit_sdk source snapshot, license, pinned source revision, and a build/install script that targets the installed PC Service SDK.
No active hardware process, service, or runtime configuration is changed.
Resource paths, checksums, and build-script syntax are verified.
decisions: Vendor PC Service and APK artifacts are internal-use resources and carry explicit do-not-externally-redistribute notices.
The Python SDK is archived as MIT-licensed source and built against the matching installed PC Service SDK rather than copied as a standalone binary module.

verification.summary: Internal PC Service and Pico APK resources were archived with checksums and installation notes; MIT SDK source and a validated build script were archived.
checks: PC Service and APK SHA-256 manifests verified
SDK source spot-check matched the recorded source build tree
SDK build script syntax passed and built/imported xrobotoolkit_sdk in a disposable environment
No hardware process or runtime configuration was changed
limitations: Vendor binary redistribution terms remain unverified; artifacts carry internal-use-only notices.
